activity_policy.browsing: Search, comments, page navigation and other identified non-media web activity are browsing, even on a video service.
activity_policy.video: Reserve video for identified video media payload. Application membership, API traffic, thumbnails, manifests, subtitles, telemetry and transport overhead do not by themselves qualify.
activity_policy.role_hints: DNS/SNI rules can suggest browsing_or_api, static_assets, telemetry, media_delivery_candidate or unknown. Hints are provisional and must not silently become traffic categories.
activity_policy.uncertainty: An application can be known while its traffic category remains unknown. Keep those records and their evidence.
activity_policy.mixed_connections: If a connection carries multiple activities, retain mixed or uncertain activity rather than marking all bytes video. Do not inherit video from another connection in the same session.
activity_policy.byte_accounting: Whole-flow byte totals are not video payload byte totals. Keep video_payload_bytes unset when encrypted or mixed traffic prevents reliable separation; never substitute total flow bytes.
activity_policy.implementation_status: Policy and rule hints only. There is no packet, request, stream or payload activity classifier yet.

matching_contract.input: DNS question/original service hostname or TLS SNI; retain the evidence type in output.
matching_contract.normalization: ASCII DNS hostnames, case-insensitive, remove one optional terminal dot; reject URLs, IP literals, ports and malformed labels. Convert IDNs to ASCII before matching.
matching_contract.exact_hostname: host == value; no automatic subdomain matching
matching_contract.ip_prefixes: No IP-prefix attribution in this pack; old ranges are not carried forward.
matching_contract.dns_correlation: A future flow labeler must scope DNS associations by client, answer chain, TTL and capture time, handle shared IPs, and avoid transferring one service label to unrelated flows sharing an IP.
matching_contract.integration: Load both existing-applications.json and additional-applications.json through scripts/hostname_rules.py, including shared_rules. This is not a drop-in Traffic Refinery config. A hostname match identifies a contacted-service candidate, not necessarily the originating application or an activity. Shared guards override apparently unique matches.

coverage: Additional target inventory services plus optional GitHub Copilot. Some entries are deliberately limited, shared-only or deferred.
